prose: Pi pod runs the pi coding agent in sandboxes on your own server. The author admires pi's simplicity and customisability and wants a minimal engineering environment around it: agent sandboxing, native clients, RBAC session sharing and browser and native app automation.
A self-hosted edition aims to feel the same as the pi harness you already use. Show HN project.
highlights: Runs the pi agent in isolated sandboxes on your own server.
Adds sandboxing, clients, RBAC sharing and automation.
Self-hosted; avoids lock-in to AI companies.
